column1: # WATCHED, NOT CERTIFIED.  These files hold the Q = T1 + T2 + T3 branch proofs.
# They are NOT in closure-c10-split.txt, are required by nothing, and are NOT
# part of the certified artifact; PHASE 1f asserts only that they keep holding
# what they are recorded here as holding.
# Added 2026-08-08.  Until now nothing gated them at all: T2 and T3 have been
# at admit=0 for weeks with no mechanism to notice if an edit to FxChain,
# RtopCSoundness or GprocVI broke them, and the defect that motivated the cli
# phase (tws_uniq passing `compile` but failing `cli`) lived in exactly these
# files.
# 2026-08-10 (second).  ALL THREE ROWS RETIRED -- T1/T2/T3 ARE NOW IN THE
# CLOSURE.  scratch/_t1.ec, _t2.ec and _t3.ec were copied to
# cdrafts-split/GprocT1Opre.ec, GprocT2Trh.ec and GprocT3Trco.ec (VERBATIM --
# byte-identical, no proof edits), a fourth file GprocQBound.ec was added with
# the composition `gproc_Q_bound`, and all four were added to
# closure-c10-split.txt.  They are therefore no longer "watched, not certified":
# PHASE 1/1d/1e now compile them as TARGETS, require them, and run them under
# BOTH drivers, and PHASE 1b/1c pin their statements in
# cert-statements-split.tsv -- strictly MORE coverage than this manifest gave.
# Leaving a watched row for a file that is now in the closure would be a false
# statement in a gate manifest, so the rows are gone rather than duplicated.
# The `-ge 3` anti-truncation floor could not express "deliberately none left",
# so it became the committed EXPECT_WATCHED=0 constant in cert_gate_split.sh --
# strictly stronger (it also catches an unexpected addition).
# THE SCRATCH ORIGINALS STAY, untracked-by-the-gate, as the development copies;
# the closure copies are the authority.
# `admits` IS AN EXACT MATCH, not a ceiling.  1 -> 2 is a regression and must
# fail; 1 -> 0 is progress and must ALSO fail, because the expectation is then
# stale and a stale expectation is how a gate stops meaning anything.  Update
# this file in the same commit as the proof.
# 2026-08-10.  _t1.ec 1 -> 0 admits: T1 IS CLOSED.  t1_opre_bound's win
# condition (T1-T5) is discharged, so the whole T1 branch of Q = T1 + T2 + T3 is
# admit-free, as T2 and T3 already were.  ALL THREE PINNED DIGESTS ARE
# UNCHANGED -- t1_opre_bound proves exactly the statement it was pinned to
# prove on 2026-08-08 while its proof was still an admit, which is what pinning
# it was for.
# The five targets went in as ONE pure lemma, t1_win, stated over plain values
# rather than inline under the pRHL `skip`: inside t1_opre_bound an iteration
# costs ~4-5 min, stated separately it costs 14 s, and the pRHL side then
# reduces to a single `apply` on hypotheses it already had by framing.  Two
# must-fail controls were graded by FAILURE REASON, not exit status: dropping
# the `!covered` premise fails at find_fresh's premise, dropping the tws size
# fails at T4's `rewrite .. hsztws`.  t1_win is deliberately NOT pinned here --
# it is a helper, like find_fresh and tws_uniq, and a drift in it cannot go
# unnoticed because t1_opre_bound would stop compiling.
# 2026-08-08 (later).  _t1.ec 1 -> 2 admits, DELIBERATE: Eqv_OCMA_sign, the
# oracle equivalence for the forge call, is now STATED and its proof deferred.
# Stating it is the check that the invariant typechecks against BOTH oracles --
# every global it names must exist on the side it names it on, with the right
# type -- which is the last plumbing that can be wrong for free.  Its digest is
# pinned here so the statement cannot drift while the proof is written.
# This is the exact-match rule doing its job: the count moved, so the manifest
# had to move with it, in the same commit.
# 2026-08-09 (third).  Eqv_OCMA_sign DIGEST MOVES ON PURPOSE, 3d9e3a2e -> b4fc971e:
# its POST now restates the PRE conjunct for conjunct.  `call (: I)` against an
# abstract adversary needs the oracle equiv in the shape `={arg} /\ I ==>
# ={res} /\ I`, and the first version DROPPED the leavess and xs
# characterisations from the post -- so the forge call in t1_opre_bound could
# not have used it.  The sign call touches neither leavess, xs nor sks, so they
# survive it; the exit gained two `exact`s and nothing else.  Admit count
# unchanged at 1.
# 2026-08-09 (second).  _t1.ec 2 -> 1 admit: Eqv_OCMA_sign IS FULLY PROVED --
# entry, body and exit.  The remaining admit is t1_opre_bound itself.
# The proof STRENGTHENED the `while` invariant with the lidxs <-> os coverage
# relation; a cli dump showed the exit obligation quantifies over the final
# `os` while the old invariant never mentioned it, i.e. that goal was not hard
# but UNPROVABLE.  Statement digests still unchanged.
# 2026-08-09.  _t1.ec 3 -> 2 admits: Eqv_OCMA_sign's LOOP BODY is discharged.
# The Eqv_OCMA_sign digest is deliberately UNCHANGED -- the proof added two
# bound conjuncts to the `while` invariant, which is proof-internal, so the
# statement did not drift while the proof was written.  That is what pinning it
# was for.  The remaining admit is the loop's entry/exit.
